join_order.notes: sub_adsh_lookup dense array index; build bitset of qualifying adsh codes + compact array of (adsh_code → name_code)
Use pre_join hash multimap index; probe with (adsh, tag, version), post-filter stmt=:stmt_eq on matched pre rows

data_structures.sub_name_lookup: compact_array(qualifying_sub_count) — struct { uint32_t adsh_code; uint32_t name_code; } sorted by adsh_code, OR reuse sub_adsh_lookup dense array for name_code lookup
data_structures.sub_name_by_adsh: dense_array[max_adsh_code] → name_code (uint32_t); only ~86K entries, ~344KB, fits in cache
data_structures.aggregation: compact_hash_map<uint128_t, AggValue> per thread — key = pack(name_code:32, tag_code:32, plabel_code:32, unused:32), value = {double sum, uint64_t count}

phase_details.scan_num_join_aggregate: parallel — morsel-driven over num rows, each thread has thread-local hash map for aggregation
phase_details.merge: serial merge of thread-local hash maps into global map

indexes.purpose: O(1) lookup: adsh_code → sub_row_id, then read name_code from sub.name[row_id]
hash multimap probe: (adsh, tag, version) → list of pre row_ids for post-filter on stmt

aggregation.key_encoding: pack 3 uint32_t (name_code, tag_code, plabel_code) into 96-bit composite key; stmt_code is constant after filter so exclude from key

output.materialization: decode name_code, tag_code, plabel_code via dictionaries only for final 200 rows (late materialization)

memory_advice.sub_columns: MADV_SEQUENTIAL, small enough to read fully
memory_advice.pre_columns: MADV_RANDOM — accessed via index lookups with non-sequential row_ids

applied_skills: L3_demand_paged_mmap — no MAP_POPULATE on any mmap
L3_raii_timer_resource_scoping — declare MMap objects at outer scope, munmap after timing
L3_compact_qualifying_arrays — sub filter uses compact bitset not full array

execution_notes.scan_loop: For each num morsel: load uom[], value_null[], adsh[], tag[], version[], value[]. Filter uom==usd_code && value_null==0 && bitset[adsh_code]. For qualifying rows: lookup sub_name_by_adsh[adsh_code] → name_code. Probe pre_join index with hash_u32x3(adsh, tag, version). For each pre match: check pre.stmt[pre_row]==is_code → read plabel_code → aggregate into thread-local map.
execution_notes.key_note: stmt_code is constant ('IS') for all output rows — include as literal in output, exclude from aggregation key to reduce key width
execution_notes.llc_budget: Thread-local hash maps: ~500K groups × 24 bytes = ~12MB each. With 64 threads = 768MB > LLC. Consider capping threads to ~3-4 for aggregation phase, OR use collect-then-aggregate pattern.
execution_notes.thread_cap_recommendation: Cap to ~16 threads for the scan+aggregate phase. Each thread's hash map ~12MB, 16 × 12MB = 192MB fits in memory but not LLC. Alternative: use two-pass — pass 1 parallel scan to collect qualifying (name_code, tag_code, plabel_code, value) tuples into compact array via two-pass scatter, pass 2 single-pass aggregation.
